items.title: File Widerspruch against denial of cost coverage
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: This is a Verwaltungsakt of a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), so delivery (Bekanntgabe) is governed by Section 37(2) SGB X: a letter sent by post within Germany is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting, unless it actually arrived later. The letter is dated Monday 14.04.2025; assuming posting on that date, day 1 = 15.04.2025, day 2 = 16.04.2025, day 3 = 17.04.2025 (Thursday, not a Sunday or NRW holiday) so Bekanntgabe (fictional delivery) = 17.04.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period runs per Section 26(1) SGB X together with Sections 187(1) and 188(2) BGB: because the period is triggered by an event (Bekanntgabe), the event day itself is excluded, and the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same calendar number as the event day, i.e. 17.05.2025. That date is a Saturday; under Section 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day. 18.05.2025 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 19.05.2025 (not an NRW public holiday). The Widerspruch must reach Muster BKK by this date.

warnings: The exact deadline depends on when the letter was actually posted and received; it is calculated here assuming postal dispatch on the printed document date (14.04.2025) using the statutory 3-day delivery fiction of Section 37 SGB X, which may differ from the true receipt date.
